xBRIEFInfo.description: Scope xBRIEF for #4410 Bound-remedy successor lean 5650046670: occupancy deny and close-out copy must not print the steal argv to the refused party.

plan.title: Occupancy deny text must not print the steal recipe to the refused party

narratives.Description: Bound-remedy 5650046670: do not print the steal argv in a message the refused party reads. Occupancy has owner/member/stranger, not human/agent. No recency guard in this story. #4409 stays separate.
narratives.Overview: Next-build is Bound-remedy from successor lean 5650046670, not the original Expected. Cover occupancy deny, --confirm-missing deny, releaseSwarmOccupancy, swarm/launch, complete-cohort, and commands.md agent-facing copy. Do not treat --confirm as a human gate. Do not ship a recency guard. Do not adopt an unevidenced convergence-protocol defect. Do not implement sibling #4409.
narratives.UserStory: As a refused occupant-stranger, I want a denial that names isolation, read-only, occupant grant, and occupant release, so I am not handed a copy-paste steal recipe.
narratives.ImplementationPlan: 1. Strip steal argv from formatOccupancyRemediation (covers occupancy deny and --confirm-missing deny). 2. Strip steal argv from releaseSwarmOccupancy, swarm launch failed-release recovery, and complete-cohort close-out. 3. Rewrite commands.md Transition/steal/release agent-facing copy. 4. Flip tests that currently require the recipe; pin that refused-party copy has no steal argv. 5. CHANGELOG Unreleased. Out of scope: recency guard, --confirm-as-human, #4409, convergence-protocol recut.
narratives.LockedDecisions: Successor lean 5650046670 is bound SoT. Synthesis accepted 5650052306. --confirm is not a human gate. Occupancy has owner/member/stranger. No recency guard ships here (if one later ships, carry replaced last_write_at or treat null as recent). Do not adopt an unevidenced convergence-protocol defect from three steal payloads. #4409 stays a separate issue.
narratives.AcceptanceJustification: Six independently pin-testable Bound-remedy surfaces plus the --confirm-is-not-human constraint.

items.title: Occupancy deny does not print the steal argv

x-directive/evidence.pointer: packages/core/src/session/occupancy.test.ts#does not print steal argv to refused party

narrative.Acceptance: Given a live occupant and a stranger write or claim, when occupancy deny runs, then the message names isolation, read-only, occupant grant, and occupant release, and does not contain session:start --steal --confirm or occupancy:steal --confirm --occupant.

items.title: --confirm-missing deny does not print the steal argv

narrative.Acceptance: Given occupancy:steal without --confirm, when the deny is printed, then it may name the missing --confirm flag of that verb and occupant recency, and does not contain session:start --steal --confirm --occupant.

items.title: releaseSwarmOccupancy deny does not print the steal argv

narrative.Acceptance: Given swarm close-out with no occupancy_session_id, unset DEFT_SESSION_ID, and no host owner, when releaseSwarmOccupancy denies, then the message does not contain session:start --steal --confirm.

items.title: swarm launch failed-release recovery does not print the steal argv

narrative.Acceptance: Given a newly claimed launch lease whose later-step release throws, when swarm:launch reports recovery, then stderr does not contain session:start --steal --confirm.

items.title: complete-cohort close-out does not print the steal argv

narrative.Acceptance: Given a live occupancy record missing or belonging to a different cohort, when complete-cohort errors, then the error does not contain session:start --steal --confirm.

items.title: commands.md agent-facing copy does not print the steal argv

narrative.Acceptance: Given content/commands.md Transition, steal, and release copy, when an agent reads it, then it does not contain session:start --steal --confirm --occupant or occupancy:steal --confirm --occupant, and still names occupant release plus ritual alignment without treating --confirm as a human gate.

references.title: Issue #4410: Occupancy deny text hands an autonomous agent the steal recipe
